Name: Tree Of Life
Description:
# Tree of Life

A monumental tree evolving slowly if cared for.

This mod adds a sacred tree to the game that will bring blessings if cared for. Fail the trees needs and it will turn into a curse.

The Tree of Life will take multiple cycles going through many stages growing to enourmous size and accommondating more and more beavers as an attraction.
It can make them (very) happy, provide them with some gifts and bountiful harvest.

A cozy gathering spot for your colony.
